prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. The ground split open between the tents and water bursting up out of the earth in a white spray, people in silhouette scrambling away, a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, resting flat and dark on the hill beyond the camp, the roof empty and flat. Night, lightning lighting the spray. Violent and sudden. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
